stored.p1: Own accounts keep a made-up name, a password (stored scrambled) and what your child does here: the games they make, their chats with the Builder and any pictures or files they add, saves, scores, ratings, favourites, friends, chat messages, a profile photo if they upload one, and settings such as language and theme. Guest play keeps a made-up name, saves, scores, ratings and favourites.

accounts.li1: Guest: for anyone who wants to play. Made with one tap on a game. Keeps a made-up name, saves, scores, ratings and favourites.

plans.li16: Paying: by card online, or by invoice (a purchase order is fine). Invoices are due 30 days after they are sent (net 30) and can be paid by card, bank transfer or ACH, or by cheque (email us for the mailing address).
plans.li25: Cancel any time online: on your family page, choose Manage billing, then cancel on Stripe's page. Schools: Manage billing on the Billing tab, or email us.

liability.p2: These limits do not apply to liability that can't be limited by law, including for our gross negligence, wilful misconduct, fraud, or personal injury caused by our negligence.

other.li3: You may not transfer your account or these terms to someone else. We may transfer them if Oomba Academy is sold or reorganised, and we will tell you.

cancel.li1: Cancel any time. There is no cancellation fee.

refunds.p7: Schools paying by invoice: the 14 days start on the date the payment reaches us. Paid by cheque? We refund by cheque or bank transfer.

board.description: Roll the dice and race along a winding path with rocket boosts and slides. Play a friend or the bot.

selfharm.suggestion: I am here to build a happy game with you whenever you want, like a cosy puppy who collects stars.

scary.suggestion: How about a silly, friendly ghost who collects sweets?

drugs.suggestion: How about a potion lab where you mix bubbly colours?

play.signInToLike: Sign in or play as a guest to save favourites.

settings.timeZoneUnset: Set your school's time zone so lessons open at midnight and due dates end at midnight where you are. Until then, nobody is late until 36 hours after the due day starts.

pay.cancel: Cancel any time in Manage billing: the plan runs to the end of the paid year.

invoice.text: For a purchase order, or a school that pays by bank transfer or cheque. We send a yearly invoice by email, due in 30 days.

price.p1: {monthly} a month or {yearly} a year, plus sales tax where it applies. Cancel any time: the plan runs to the end of the period you paid for.
price.both: Basic is {basic} a month, for one child. Family is {family} a month, for up to {max} children. Plus sales tax where it applies. Cancel any time: the plan runs to the end of the period you paid for.

cancel.a: Yes, any time. The plan runs to the end of the period you paid for, then your children go back to the free messages. Nothing they made is deleted.

terms.cancel: Cancel any time in Manage billing. The plan keeps working until the end of the period you paid for.

fine.tax: Prices are in US dollars, plus sales tax where it applies. Basic and Family plans are for US families for now. A plan renews until you cancel it, and you can cancel any time.
